messages:
alice: Quick idea — should we add a small 'runtime profile' step to model onboarding? a fast perf bench (seq 128/512) to catch regressions before models hit canary.
ben: +1 to catching regressions early. main worry is cost and flaky infra noise.
clare: Agree useful. maybe 3 runs and take median to reduce noise. also KV warmup could help.
anita: We also need a compatibility check for KV cache layout & q-format offsets. last q4 change caused wrong offsets for kv indices.
josh: Proposal: two gates — `sanity` (smoke perf + quick correctness) and `compat` (deeper bench + artifact checks). sanity must finish within 5m, compat can be async/longer.
devinfra-bot: Deploy job queued: onboard-bench/1768888888 started
alice: Metrics to capture: p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, GPU memory peak, cpu-side latency, and model artifact hash (git/model-binary) + inference config.
ben: Suggest storing a small perf artifact (json, ~100 lines) in S3 with signed URL for audits and diffing.
clare: Tradeoff: dev velocity vs coverage. maybe make compat gate optional for experimental models or flagged models.
anita: Also add a tiny semantic regression check: eval set (~50 prompts). if embedding cosine drift > 0.05 or answer-f1 drops > 2% then fail.
josh: Integrate with rollout: if compat fails, block canary and auto-fallback to previous deployed variant; if sanity fails, block entirely.
alice: Bench harness example command we can run in CI:
```
./bench_tool --model s3://models/abc --seq 128 --reps 3 --warmup 50 --metrics p50,p95,mem
```
ben: For noise, use dedicated tiny pool (1 GPU) with pinned infra during bench. also capture kernel/cudnn versions in artifact.
clare: I'll draft sampling rules for the eval prompts and guardrails for synthetic vs real user inputs.
anita: I'll define compatibility assertions for q formats and KV layout: canonical offsets, dtype mapping, and a checksum.
josh: I'll update rollout playbook to add explicit fallback steps and a human-in-loop escalation if compat flakes repeatedly.
alice: Action items: 1) RFC for `onboard-runtime-profile` API + artifacts (ben + clare) 2) gating TTL + retry policy (josh) 3) cost estimate + runbook (ben) 4) compat assertions doc (anita).
ben: I'll prototype the bench harness this week and push a toy job.
clare: I'll start writing the eval sampler and a small test corpus.
anita: Working on q-format checks, will open a PR with spec.
josh: I'll add the auto-fallback config to rollout infra and link to canary rules.
alice: Great — please ping when PRs land. aim for draft RFC by Thu EOD. :rocket:
ben: Will do.
clare: noted.
devinfra-bot: Job onboard-bench/1768888888 completed: success :white_check_mark:
